name: Motto! Haramase! Honoo no Oppai Isekai Ero Mahou Gakuen!
original_name: もっと！孕ませ！炎のおっぱい異世界エロ魔法学園！
source:
Takumi Kazuya is just an average student at Iseumi Academy who has been suffering from delusions of grandeur since a young age. He dreams of conquering the literary world by becoming a best-selling erotica novelist and having his works adapted into anime. One day, when Takumi is taking his usual two-hour bath while thinking up plots for his new novels, his sister gets upset with him. This is no unusual occurrence, and normally the tantrums of his sister, an aspiring eromanga artist herself, only serve to amuse Takumi. This time, however, she decides to turn up the bath thermostat to the maximum temperature. It was meant to be nothing but a silly prank, but then alarms start ringing—the kind you might hear in a disaster movie—and the bathtub starts making ominous noises, as if it's about to explode! Takumi's life starts flashing before his eyes, and before he realizes what's going on, he finds himself enveloped by nothingness...
"As he struggles towards the light, trying to find an exit, he suddenly falls into a large body of water. Unlike the small bath he was in moments ago, this appears to be a large, public pool, and... it's filled with busty girls in bikinis!? This must be heaven!
Taking a closer look, he notices that not all the girls are human. They appear to be from a variety of species, and their reactions to the sudden intruder are just as diverse as their looks. Some even start summoning magic circles and shooting arrows of light! If this were a light novel, they would probably challenge him to a duel after seeing them in their swimwear, and his maxed-out luck stat would allow him to win and instantly earn their affection... Or at least, that's what Takumi fantasizes about as he narrowly escapes from the otherworldly pool into which he has just reincarnated.
Said pool turns out to belong to the prestigious Yggdrasil Girls' Magical Academy, and Takumi will be its first male student. Will he be able to conquer the hearts of the entire academy!?"

translation:
“拓海和也只是伊势美学园的一名普通学生，从小就饱受虚荣妄想的困扰。他梦想成为一名畅销情色小说家，并将其作品改编成动画，从而征服文坛。有一天，拓海一边像往常一样洗澡两个小时，一边思考新小说的情节，他的姐姐对他感到不高兴。这并不是什么不寻常的事情，通常他的妹妹（一位有抱负的色情漫画艺术家）的发脾气只会让拓海感到高兴。然而，这一次，她决定将浴缸恒温器调至最高温度。这本来只是一个愚蠢的恶作剧，但随后警报开始响起——就像你在灾难电影中听到的那样——浴缸开始发出不祥的声音，就好像它即将爆炸一样！拓海的人生开始在他眼前闪现，还没等他意识到发生了什么，他就发现自己被虚无所笼罩……
“当他挣扎着向着光亮寻找出口时，突然掉进了一大片水里。和刚才的小浴池不同，这里像是一个大型的公共泳池，而且……里面全是穿着比基尼的巨乳妹子！？这一定是天堂啊！”
仔细一看，他发现并非所有女孩都是人类。它们似乎来自不同的物种，它们对突然入侵者的反应就像它们的外表一样多种多样。有些人甚至开始召唤魔法阵并射出光之箭！如果这是一本轻小说，看到他们穿着泳装后，他们可能会向他发起决斗，而他的运气数值满分，会让他获胜并立即赢得他们的好感……或者至少，这是拓海在刚刚转生的异界泳池中险些逃脱时所幻想的。
这个池子原来属于著名的Yggdrasil女子魔法学院，而拓海将是该学院的第一位男学生。他能征服整个学园的心吗！？”
